title.zh: U.S. SEC's steadiest crypto advocate, Hester Peirce, to depart next week
title.en: U.S. SEC's steadiest crypto advocate, Hester Peirce, to depart next week

current_state.zh: SEC Commissioner Hester Peirce, the agency's most prominent crypto advocate known as 'Crypto Mom,' announced she will leave the commission on Oct. 2, a departure disclosed as the SEC issued further crypto policy guidance.
current_state.en: SEC Commissioner Hester Peirce, the agency's most prominent crypto advocate known as 'Crypto Mom,' announced she will leave the commission on Oct. 2, a departure disclosed as the SEC issued further crypto policy guidance.
